title: IRC plaintext on a verified tailnet address (decision mimid-1wgh.91)
description:
Implements decision mimid-1wgh.91: a plain IRC listener may bind a tailnet address when tailscaled confirms it is ours, with every connection's peer checked by Tailscale WhoIs. Fails closed: no tailscaled, no answer, or an answer that does not name our own tailnet means the plain listener does not bind.

NOT YET PLANNED. Per AGENTS.md this needs a plan in this field, reviewed by Mark, before any sub-issues or code. Prior research to build on: frontend-auth.md around lines 800 to 830 already covers the tailscaled LocalAPI, WhoIs and the loopback LocalAPI server, and tls.rs already talks to the LocalAPI for source="tailscale" certificates, so the client side exists.

Known scope from the decision: enforcement at mimid-agent config.rs:492 and mimid-agent-irc listen.rs:116; the accept loop's own is_loopback drop at listen.rs:224; tests config.rs:833 and front_end_auth.rs:262; documents AGENTS.md (crate-map row and the security-invariant table), frontend-auth.md:125, :533, :825, client-survey.md S1.

Open question for Mark, raised in the decision and not settled: whether the agent's HTTP listener for JMAP Chat (config.rs:464) gets the same exception or stays loopback-only.
close_reason: Superseded unstarted by decision mimid-1wgh.92: the plain IRC listener may bind any address, so the tailnet-only WhoIs exception of mimid-1wgh.91 is moot.
